description: T-4130: does Excel for the web refresh a pivot after its source changes (PivotTable Auto Refresh), and does it save an Auto Refresh setting in the file? Data!A1:B4 has Region and Sales: East (B2 blank in the file), West 20, East 5. The oracle types 100 into Data!B2 after load (`entered`, a Graph range write), then runs a full-rebuild calculate and no pivot refresh. AR0 holds a pivot saved without refreshOnLoad whose saved cells and rowItems show East 5, West 20, Grand Total 25 (the render of the file's blank B2); AR1 a refreshOnLoad pivot over the same source. Both are rows Region, Sum of Sales. An auto-refreshed pivot shows East 105 and Grand Total 125. The pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 reads Data!B2 back and Q!B1 sums the source.
